title: Improved strategy for large scale isolation of sialylglycopeptide (SGP) from egg yolk powder
author: Alagesan, Kolarich

steps.title: Resuspend egg yolk powder
steps.instruction: Add 250 g of egg yolk powder to 750 mL Milli‑Q water (1:3 w/v) in a suitable vessel and stir at room temperature for 2 h (or overnight if preferred).

steps.title: Add methanol and stir
steps.instruction: Add 500 mL methanol (2 vol relative to the water) to the suspension, mix, and stir for an additional 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Aliquot and centrifuge first
steps.instruction: Dispense the mixture into 40 mL portions using 50 mL Falcon tubes, then centrifuge each tube at 3000 × g, 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Add chloroform and centrifuge
steps.instruction: To each tube add 10 mL chloroform, mix thoroughly, and centrifuge again at 3000 × g, 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase and concentrate
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the upper aqueous phase (which contains the sialylglycopeptide) from each tube, combine the pooled aqueous fractions, and remove solvent under reduced pressure with a rotary evaporator.

steps.title: Gel‑filtration purification
steps.instruction: Load the concentrated crude solution onto a Sephadex G‑50 (fine) column (25 × 935 mm), elute with 100 mM ammonium acetate (pH 7) at a flow rate of 1 mL min⁻¹ and 10 °C.

steps.title: Collect and pool positive fractions
steps.instruction: Collect sixty 10 mL fractions; test each for resorcinol positivity and pool all positive fractions together.
